runtime_evidence.reason: The LLM endpoint is an audited local fixture. The server, AI service configuration, read-only tools, SQLite and browser are real; no GPU, agent, container or vendor model is claimed.

crud.create: UI Add AI Service creates a default custom endpoint through POST /ai/configs; the upstream key is never returned
crud.read: The settings row and independent GET keep the non-secret service fields after refresh
crud.update: N/A: the service card offers create and delete, not edit
crud.delete: UI delete confirmation removes the configuration; independent GET returns an empty list

fields.component: Modal with preset, name, URL, model, password and default switch

missing: all vendor presets

editing an existing service
